A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same Gaussian-mixture and SmolLM2 distillation study. The text, equations, figures, results table and appendices are readable and support reliable comparison across relocations and renumbering.

before.justification: Sections 3.2 and 4.3–4.4 report original Gaussian-mixture simulations, SmolLM2 training results in Table 1, and embedding visualizations.

after.justification: The original simulations and language-model experiments remain, with Figure 4 reporting precision and recall distributions across five seeds.

M1.justification: Teacher-weight reparameterization, forward-KL distillation, the Gaussian-mixture models and the SmolLM2 training pipeline are unchanged. No new algorithmic component or objective is introduced.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same eight-component Gaussian distribution and synthetic SmolLM2 language-modeling data. Appendix B's summarization, reasoning and chain-of-thought examples are conceptual extensions, not evaluated tasks.

E2.justification: The directly trained Gaussian student and directly trained 135M student remain the comparison baselines. Newly cited generative-distillation methods are discussed but are not experimentally evaluated.

E3.justification: Model sizes, four teacher temperatures, 10M-example training datasets, 100,000-example evaluations and precision/recall definitions are retained. Appendix A already specified five teacher epochs and one student epoch in v1. Newly reported seed information belongs to E5.

E4.justification: The temperature comparison, Gaussian contour analysis and UMAP analysis are retained. The UMAP panels are reordered rather than newly analyzed, and Appendix B adds discussion without downstream experiments or case-study evidence.

E5.justification: Uncertainty reporting is introduced for the central LLM comparison. Section 4.2 newly specifies five random seeds, and Figure 4 presents interquartile ranges with arithmetic means instead of Table 1's point estimates. Since v1 gives no run count, this does not establish an explicit increase from one run to five.

E6.justification: The LLM point estimates are replaced by different five-seed summaries. For example, temperature 1.0 precision changes from -4.5213 in v1 Table 1 to approximately -5.0 in v2 Figure 4. These are revised summaries, not demonstrated same-run performance changes. Simulation precision/recall values and the overall temperature trend remain unchanged.

T1.justification: The mixture assumptions, entropy reparameterization, KL/Jensen derivation, difficulty formula and precision/recall definitions are retained. Figure 2's difficulty description changes from zero to close to zero, without revising the formal analysis.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same central contribution: teacher selectivity induces a precision–recall trade-off, illustrated through Gaussian mixtures and validated using SmolLM2. Wording edits and additional supporting reporting do not redefine this claim.

C2.justification: New Appendix B interprets distributional modes as skills or tasks, explaining focused competence alongside lost generalist coverage and reduced diversity of reasoning styles. These downstream interpretations extend the discussion without new validation; the existing limitation to pretraining experiments remains.

D1.justification: V2 adds a first-page code-availability statement with a repository address. The hardware, optimization, preprocessing, checkpoint selection and UMAP settings in Appendix A were already supplied in v1 and are retained.

R1.justification: Section 2 adds MiniLLM, On-policy Distillation of Language Models, and f-divergence Minimization for Sequence-Level Knowledge Distillation. A focused new paragraph distinguishes teacher selectivity under standard forward KL and the three-stage framework from specialized distillation objectives; the remaining positioning is largely retained.

P1.justification: V2 makes localized prose and heading edits, updates the publication header, moves Appendix A after the references and adds Appendix B. The main section sequence and most existing exposition remain intact.

P2.justification: Table 1 becomes a two-panel box-plot figure, Figure 1 is enlarged, and the retained UMAP panels are reversed with corrected subfigure labels, becoming Figure 5. These changes reflow the pages while preserving the other principal graphics.

improvement.justification: Five-seed variability reporting makes the central LLM evidence more assessable than v1's point estimates. Clearer prior-work comparisons and a code-access statement also help. These gains outweigh the loss of exact tabulated LLM scores and the unvalidated downstream extrapolations in Appendix B, but the experimental scope and underlying analysis remain largely unchanged.
